node.statement: Let C_diag < infinity and e_diag > 0 be universal witnesses from lem-hcb3-diagonal-lower-modulus. Enlarging C_diag if necessary preserves that external conclusion, so take C_diag > 0 and define e_inv := min{e_diag,(2*C_diag)^(-1)} and C_inv := 2*C_diag. Then e_inv > 0 and C_inv < infinity are universal, and 0 <= C_diag*e <= 1/2 whenever 0 <= e <= e_inv.
